title: solar.pvdaq.dataset.validated.v1
description: CloudEvents v1.0 envelope emitted by processing-func onto the queue dataset-validated once validated records have been written to the silver container. Replaces the flat-JSON dataset.bronze.available message. Target state per ADR 0001 (silver_path), ADR 0002 (CloudEvents envelope, versioned type, dataschema) and ADR 0003 (correlation_id + traceparent).

specversion.description: CloudEvents spec version. Absent today: the outbound message is flat JSON (ADR 0002).

type.description: Describes what happened to the data, not where it was put, so a layer rename cannot force an event rename (ADR 0002 rule 3).

id.description: Unique event identifier. Also set as the Service Bus MessageId.

time.description: Emission timestamp. Supersedes the flat message's published_at, which carried the same meaning.

datacontenttype.description: Content type of the data member. The Service Bus message itself carries application/cloudevents+json (ADR 0002 rule 4).

dataschema.description: ADR 0002 rule 2: pins the exact contract in the registry. Equals this schema's $id.

source_vendor.description: Propagated from the triggering dataset-available event.

schema_version.description: Vendor record-schema version used for validation, propagated from the triggering event. Promoted from the flat payload to an envelope attribute so both events carry one envelope shape.

correlation_id.description: ADR 0003 business key, propagated unchanged from the triggering dataset-available event. Also set on the Service Bus message's CorrelationId property.

traceparent.description: ADR 0003: W3C trace context of the processing span, carried in the Service Bus application properties and duplicated here as the durable record.

data.description: Validated-dataset payload. Open by construction (ADR 0002 rule 2): additive fields are a minor version and must not break a consumer validating against this copy.

dataset_id.description: Logical dataset identifier {site_id}_{category}, matching the triggering event.

record_count.description: Canonical records written to silver. Zero is legal: row-level quarantine (ADR 0001, R3.4) admits a file whose every row is rejected, so this relaxes the superseded contract's minimum of 1.

silver_path.description: Absolute blob-endpoint URI of the written Parquet partition (ADR 0001 renames bronze_path to silver_path; ADR 0005 fixes the blob form). A file spanning two data dates writes two partitions; this names the partition root for the dataset.

uuid.description: Lowercase canonical UUID. The pattern is carried alongside the format so validation is deterministic wherever format assertion is disabled.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit offset.

allOf.description: W3C forbids an all-zero trace-id; it is also the signature of a synthesised context (ADR 0003).
